name: safari-compat.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  safari-compat.scss
//  Safari / iOS compatibility overrides — loaded ONLY via safari-loader.js.
//
//  ⚠  NEVER import this from app.scss or any component stylesheet.
//     Modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari 16+) never download this file.
//
//  Loading condition: !CSS.supports('container-type', 'inline-size')
//  catches: iOS < 16, macOS Safari < 16, and all legacy WebKit browsers.
//
//  Each @supports not block is a secondary safety net — the file is harmless
//  if accidentally loaded in a modern browser.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';

// ── 1. aspect-ratio on position:absolute and flex-child elements ───────────
//  iOS 14–15.x bug: aspect-ratio is silently ignored on position:absolute
//  elements and behaves inconsistently on flex children. The elements end up
//  with height:0, breaking the entire carousel layout.
//  Fix: the CSS padding-top trick — padding-% is always relative to width,
//  so `padding-top: 43.75%` on a width:100% element equals height = 7/16ths.
//  Modern browsers that DO support aspect-ratio are never served this file.
//
@supports not (aspect-ratio: 1) {
  // ── Awards carousel: selected work ────────────────────────────────────────

  // Controls overlay — position:absolute, height driven by aspect-ratio in
  // modern CSS, broken on iOS 14-15.x. Restore height via padding-top.
  .aw-c--selected .aw-c-controls {
    height: 0;
    padding-top: 43.75%; // 7 ÷ 16 = 43.75%
  }

  // Cover image wrapper — flex child with aspect-ratio; iOS needs padding-top.
  .aw-c--selected .aw-c-cover {
    height: 0;
    padding-top: 43.75%;
    position: relative; // creates the BFC the absolutely-positioned img needs

    // Image fills the padding-box
    &-img {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
    }
  }

  // Cover skeleton — same shape as the live cover image
  .aw-c--selected .aw-c-cover--skel {
    height: 0;
    padding-top: 43.75%;
  }

  // ── Internals: related mosaic grid ──────────────────────────────────────

  .related-mosaic-item,
  .rltd-ms-item {
    height: 0;
    padding-bottom: 62.5%; // 10 ÷ 16 = 62.5%
  }

  // ── Structure: hero skeleton ────────────────────────────────────────────
  .skeleton--hero {
    height: 0;
    padding-top: 43.75%; // 7 ÷ 16 = 43.75%
  }
}

// Featured mosaic card (aspect-ratio: 16/9 at 1024+)
// Written outside the @supports not block to allow @include layout-1024()
// — Sass cannot nest @include mixins inside @supports not blocks in older Sass.
.related-mosaic-item--featured,
.rltd-ms-item--featured {
  @include layout-1024() {
    @supports not (aspect-ratio: 1) {
      height: 0;
      padding-bottom: 56.25%; // 9 ÷ 16 = 56.25%
    }
  }
}

// ── 2. contain: layout style — flex-column height collapse ────────────────
//  iOS < 15.4: `contain: style` is not recognised. The full shorthand
//  `contain: layout style` becomes an invalid declaration and is DROPPED.
//  On certain WebKit builds this causes the flex column to collapse to 0
//  when min-height resolves to 'auto'. Force contain:none as a safety net.
//
@supports not (contain: style) {
  .internal-description {
    contain: none;
  }
}

// ── 3. container-type: inline-size ────────────────────────────────────────
//  iOS < 16: container queries are not supported. cqw values already have
//  rem fallbacks inside each clamp() call in hm.scss, so the
//  layout won't break — but we reset container-type so WebKit doesn't try
//  to create a broken partial containment context.
//
@supports not (container-type: inline-size) {
  .home-mosaic-item,
  .hm-item {
    container-type: normal;
  }
}

// ── 4. Safari text block min-height reset ────────────────────────────────
// On Safari, stacked sections must not inherit runaway min-height from carousels.
.internal-description {
  min-height: auto;
}

// Keyboard focus ring on this shadow root's tabbable elements — the file
// doesn't import _structure (which emits it globally), so include the
// shared scope explicitly.
@include focus-ring-scope;
